english.title: Fail to take measures when managing extractive waste to prevent contraventions and the escape of waste
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), being a person responsible for the management of extractive waste, failed to take all such measures applicable to you in that capacity, as were reasonable in the circumstances, to prevent

(A)_[a contravention by another person of section 33 of the Environmental Protection Act 1990]_
(B)_[a contravention by another person of regulation 12 of the Environmental Permitting (England and Wales) Regulations 2016 or of a condition of an environmental permit]_
(C)_[the escape of the waste from his control or that of any other person]_

in that **(..SPECIFY FAILURE..)
english.legislation: Contrary to section 34(1A) and (6) of the Environmental Protection Act 1990.
english.pointstoprove:
date and location
being responsible for the management of extractive waste
failed to take all measures applicable to him
that were reasonable in the circumstances
to prevent any contravention by any other person of section 33 OR
to prevent any contravention by another person of regulation 12 of the Environmental Permitting (England and Wales) Regulations 2016 or of a condition of an environmental permit OR
to prevent the escape of the waste from his control or that of any other person

investigatoraction.description: Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

english.notes: This offence wording document provides for the offence under section 34(1A); prior to 7th January 2019, this offence was included under EP90024, which has been split to provide a separate offence wording for each subsection covered by that document. See also EP90023 in relation to subsection (1), EP90137 in relation to subsection (2A), and EP90138 in relation to subsection (5).

other.penalty:
Summary: A fine not exceeding the statutory maximum.
Indictment: A fine.

Time limit for prosecutions:
None

Note
On the 12th March 2015 the limit on fines imposed by a Magistrates' court was removed – as such, the potential fine on summary conviction in relation to an offence committed after this date is unlimited.
